observations: The page number «( 2 )» stands at the head of the page, centred. The page has no signature.

L03: the four points after «diuersitas» mark the place of the figures that show the differences between the forms of the letters, which the edition does not print; the editor's footnote (1) says that the gap is in the manuscript too, at fol. 102 recto, line 22.
L13: «indiget indiget (sic)»: the edition prints the word twice and marks the repetition with «(sic)» in italics, as the manuscript has it.

L17: the vertical bar between «enim» and «possunt» marks the beginning of fol. 102 verso of the manuscript, which the note in the left margin, «car. 102 verso.», names (on the left-hand pages the folio notes stand in the left margin); transcribed as a margin note.
L23: the text spells the name «algorizmi» here, where p. 1 has «algoritmi» (frame 007, L05, L16).

Spaces at punctuation: L16, L17 and L23 are set tightly, with word spaces of 13 to 19 px. After «tria,» (L16), «diximus,», «dicam,» and «re.» (L17) and «Inueni,» (L23) the gap before the next word is 4 to 8 px, the spacing of the punctuation itself, and no space is transcribed; before the colon of L16 the gap is 6 px. Elsewhere the page sets a space before «;» (L06), «:» (L13) and «,» (L30), as transcribed.
copy_matter: A reader's marks in pencil: L03, a vertical stroke through the final «e» of «algebre»; L09, a stroke under «quare»; L10, a small curve between «per» and «se»; L27, an oblique stroke after «.ix.»; L30, an oblique stroke after «.xc.». In the left margin, in ink or dark pencil: «quia» beside L09, and the sign «§» beside L27 and L30. Not part of the edition.
